title: Manage IT portfolio strategy
goal: Every IT project and paid system the venture is carrying is scored against the same written value criteria, the founder has set the order, and what the venture will not do this quarter is written down too.

steps.do: Write the criteria by which an IT project earns its place (hours saved a month, money saved a month, a risk removed, a record the venture comes to own, a compliance obligation met) and check each one against a live goal's measure, dropping any criterion no goal measures.

Split what the venture spends and plans to spend on IT into keeping the lights on, removing risk and building something new, name the share each takes today, and say which share is out of line with the venture's phase.
Score each proposed project on the criteria, with the number for each criterion and the record it came from, and mark any score that is a guess as a guess.
Put the scored list to the founder as one decision, with your recommended order, what each project would displace and what the venture would not do, and let the founder set the order.

For the order the founder set, say which agent role or person does each project, what access each needs that it does not have, and which of them collide because one person or one credential is in both.
Write each project next to the goal and measure it serves, and name every project that serves no live goal so the founder can drop it.

Record the order and the scores as evidence on the decisions they settle, and raise for the founder each project that needs money, wider access or new terms, and each paid system the portfolio no longer justifies.

done_criteria.check: Is every project scored on the same written criteria with its numbers traced to a record, and did the founder set the order in a decision that also says what the venture will not do?
